sources.entry: gymnasium - A standard API for reinforcement learning environments with popular reference environments (gym successor).

summary.one_liner: Gymnasium is a Python library that provides a standard API for reinforcement learning environments, along with a set of reference environments; it is a maintained fork of OpenAI's Gym.
summary.what_it_does: Defines a common interface (reset/step with observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info) so RL algorithms and environments can be swapped without custom glue code. Ships reference environment families including Classic Control, Box2D, Toy Text, MuJoCo, and Atari. Environments are created with gymnasium.make("CartPole-v1") and interacted with through action and observation spaces. Third-party environments compatible with the API are supported, with apply_env_compatibility in gymnasium.make for older versions. Environment IDs carry version suffixes (e.g. -v0, -v1) so results stay reproducible when environments change. The README also points to CleanRL and PettingZoo as related libraries.
use_cases: benchmarking RL algorithms on standard environments
comparing RL algorithms on a common API
prototyping agents on CartPole or Atari games
debugging RL implementations with simple Toy Text environments
running physics-based control tasks with MuJoCo or Box2D
how_to_run: import gymnasium as gym; env = gym.make("CartPole-v1")
observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step(action)
notable: Maintained successor to OpenAI Gym, with maintenance moved to the Farama Foundation
Standard reset/step API that separates terminated and truncated signals
Optional install extras per environment family, such as [atari] or [all]
Documentation at gymnasium.farama.org and a Discord server
caveats: Base install excludes dependencies for most environment families; some are problematic on certain systems
Third-party environments may need apply_env_compatibility if built for an older API version
keywords: train an agent to play games
